fields.name: mintAuthority
docs: Optional authority used to mint new tokens. The mint authority may only
be provided during mint creation. If no mint authority is present
then the mint has a fixed supply and no further tokens may be minted.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Number of base 10 digits to the right of the decimal place.

fields.name: isInitialized
docs: Is `true` if this structure has been initialized.

fields.name: freezeAuthority
docs: Optional authority to freeze token accounts.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.authority}, the program's upgrade authority, initializes the CCIP lock-release pool program with default router ${data.routerAddress} and RMN Remote ${data.rmnAddress}
${accounts.authority}, the program's upgrade authority, sets whether a token's mint authority may create its own CCIP lock-release pool: ${data.selfServedAllowed}
${accounts.authority}, the program's upgrade authority, sets the CCIP router new pools start with to ${data.routerAddress}
${accounts.authority}, the program's upgrade authority, sets the RMN Remote program new pools start with to ${data.rmnAddress}
${accounts.authority} creates the CCIP lock-release pool for ${accounts.mint} and becomes its owner

instructions.name: typeVersion
docs: Returns the program type (name) and version.
Used by offchain code to easily determine which program & version is being interacted with.

display.interpolatedIntent: Reads the name and version of the CCIP lock-release pool program
${accounts.authority}, the pool owner, proposes ${data.proposedOwner} as the new owner of the CCIP pool for ${accounts.mint}, who must accept it
${accounts.authority} becomes the owner of the CCIP pool for ${accounts.mint}
${accounts.authority}, the program's upgrade authority and the pool's owner, sets the CCIP router of the pool for ${accounts.mint} to ${data.newRouter}
${accounts.authority}, the program's upgrade authority and the pool's owner, sets the RMN Remote program of the CCIP pool for ${accounts.mint} to ${data.rmnAddress}
Sets the version of the CCIP pool for ${data.mint}, which its creation left unset

${accounts.authority}, the pool owner, adds remote chain selector ${data.remoteChainSelector} to the CCIP pool for ${data.mint}, where its token is ${data.cfg.tokenAddress.address} with ${data.cfg.decimals} decimals

${accounts.authority}, the pool owner, sets the token of remote chain selector ${data.remoteChainSelector} in the CCIP pool for ${data.mint} to ${data.cfg.tokenAddress.address} with ${data.cfg.decimals} decimals, and replaces its remote pools
${accounts.authority}, the pool owner, adds remote pools for remote chain selector ${data.remoteChainSelector} to the CCIP pool for ${data.mint}

display.label: Pool Owner or Rate Limit Administrator

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.authority} sets the inbound and outbound rate limits between the CCIP pool for ${data.mint} and remote chain selector ${data.remoteChainSelector}
${accounts.authority}, the pool owner, sets ${data.newRateLimitAdmin} as the rate limit administrator of the CCIP pool for ${data.mint}
${accounts.authority}, the pool owner, removes remote chain selector ${data.remoteChainSelector} from the CCIP pool for ${data.mint}

display.intent: Add to the sender allow list
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.authority}, the pool owner, adds senders to the allow list of the CCIP pool for ${accounts.mint} and sets the list on: ${data.enabled}

display.intent: Remove from the sender allow list
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.authority}, the pool owner, removes senders from the allow list of the CCIP pool for ${accounts.mint}

accounts.name: offrampProgram
docs: CHECK offramp program: exists only to derive the allowed offramp PDA

accounts.name: allowedOfframp
docs: CHECK PDA of the router program verifying the signer is an allowed offramp.
If PDA does not exist, the router doesn't allow this offramp

display.intent: Release tokens from a cross-chain send
display.interpolatedIntent: Releases ${accounts.mint} tokens from the CCIP pool to ${data.releaseOrMint.receiver}, for a message from source chain selector ${data.releaseOrMint.remoteChainSelector} sent by ${data.releaseOrMint.originalSender.address}

display.intent: Lock tokens for a cross-chain send
display.interpolatedIntent: Locks ${data.lockOrBurn.amount} of ${accounts.mint} in the CCIP pool for a send by ${data.lockOrBurn.originalSender} to receiver ${data.lockOrBurn.receiver} on destination chain selector ${data.lockOrBurn.remoteChainSelector}
${accounts.authority}, the pool owner, sets ${data.rebalancer} as the rebalancer of the CCIP pool for ${accounts.mint}, who may provide and withdraw its liquidity
${accounts.authority}, the pool owner, sets whether the CCIP pool for ${accounts.mint} lets its rebalancer provide and withdraw liquidity: ${data.allow}
${accounts.authority}, the pool's rebalancer, moves ${data.amount} of ${accounts.mint} from ${accounts.remoteTokenAccount} into the CCIP pool
${accounts.authority}, the pool's rebalancer, withdraws ${data.amount} of ${accounts.mint} from the CCIP pool to ${accounts.remoteTokenAccount}

display.label: Amount Sent (32-byte little-endian number, in the source token's decimals)

fields.name: sourcePoolAddress
docs: @dev WARNING: sourcePoolAddress should be checked prior to any processing of funds. Make sure it matches the
expected pool address for the given remoteChainSelector.
